situation (example wording): A question that leaves out its year, place or crime
what the app does today: Some paths assume a default (latest year, the nation, all years); bare "crime" is asked about (rule 9).
proposed behavior: Ask, with buttons, most likely choice first; never assume. Each button runs the whole question with that part filled in.
exact default or choices offered: See P05, P06 and P12 for the buttons offered.
why: A missing part changes the answer; one click is cheaper than a wrong assumption.
status: Superseded by P180, P181 and P182 (2026-11-21: a missing place, period or kind of crime takes the default, said in a note); Decided 2026-10-28 (Jeff: general rule)
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts, scripts/test-nibrs-hate.ts.
